title: VideoReferenceService
responsibility: Resolve archived video references through exact owner and attached original-parent proof, preserving original capture identity and keeping current-input admission as a separate caller obligation.

inputs.name: VideoReferenceService.constructor.root
inputs.description: The optional snapshot/root binding for this operation. Its documented default is the source expression process.cwd(), evaluated at construction, not a literal path string.

inputs.name: VideoReferenceService.constructor.pinned
inputs.description: The optional snapshot/root binding for this operation. Omission reads current evidence and notes tips when the reference scope is established; explicit null snapshot bounds are never widened.

inputs.name: VideoReferenceService.materialize.physical
inputs.description: The optional snapshot/root binding for this operation. Omission derives physical capture paths from recordFiles(record); this list is only used to reject conflicts with virtual referenced media.

outputs.name: safeReferencePath
outputs.description: Returns a boolean from a string path without opening files.

outputs.name: createReferenceCache
outputs.description: Allocates empty in-memory metadata caches without external work.

outputs.name: originKey
outputs.description: Hashes the declared string-based scope/trail/record identity without external work.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The source, owner/slot, ancestry, hash seal, bounded media, poster, timeline or filesystem destination fails the operation’s explicit integrity checks.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: A supplied or retained pointer, slot, clip, batch or manifest fails its runtime schema; no malformed descriptor is admitted.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Retained batch/manifest or source-owner JSON cannot be parsed; the original parse failure propagates.

errors.name: Git/LFS collaborator rejection
errors.description: A Git/evidence-tree/LFS collaborator can reject; this operation does not establish a narrower rejection shape and does not turn it into verification success.

errors.name: Filesystem rejection
errors.description: A bounded filesystem operation can reject with its original error/code; this is a failure category rather than an invented runtime error class.

errors.name: Loader rejection
errors.description: The supplied loader may throw or reject. Its original failure propagates and failed work is not retained as successful memoized proof.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Memoization measures the loader result with JSON.stringify; a cyclic or unsupported runtime value cannot be measured and rejects the call.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: JSON.stringify may exceed the call stack on an excessively deep loader result.
